thesis: Out of Life: he walks down through the container stalls after the man in the orange coat, looking for a way out.
character: HIM: a Black man in his thirties with close-cropped hair and a short beard, wearing a matte black mock-neck long sleeve, black trousers and black boots. THE OTHER MAN: a tall Black man in his thirties in a long orange coat, dark trousers and boots, always walking ahead with his back to us, never turning round. THE CROWD: Black women and men in everyday clothes, standing at the stalls.

shots.action: Night. He stands at the top of a long corridor of stacked shipping-container stalls and looks down it.
He walks down between the container stalls looking for a way out, past fire escapes and lit hatches.
He walks into a crowd under strings of light; far ahead the man in the orange coat walks away from him.
He follows the man in the orange coat down a narrow stair alley between the containers.
He walks into a dark underpass; the man in the orange coat is ahead of him and the shadows pool on the ground.
He pauses in drifting vapour outside a lit teahouse; photographs hang on strings across the alley.
The man in the orange coat walks ahead with his back to him, toward a fire escape; he follows.
He climbs the fire escape after him and steps off the top into the dark.

third_person: THIRD PERSON, like an open-world video game. The camera floats two metres behind him and a little above his shoulders. He is centred in the lower half of the frame, his whole body visible from behind, about one third of the frame's height. The camera follows him and never passes him or looks away from him.

styles.greyfig: STYLE: a grey-box video game world. Flat untextured blocks, small lit yellow squares for windows, flat ground, simple block figures. Keep this exact flat blocky look; add no texture or realism. The man walking away from us in the lower middle of the starting picture is him: keep him exactly there, seen from behind.
